name: Kentucky
source:
Yo! I'm the Kentucky Rifle. I was created when the Pennsylvania Rifle got improved in Kentucky!
Since I'm handmade by a gunsmith, there isn't a single one exactly the same—I'm a rifle brimming with originality.

My motto is one shot, one kill. It's nothing like the tactics of some British blokes who just spray and pray.

Please, Master, take a good look at what I can do!
